rationale_bullets: Kaliakmanis (88.8 PFF/463 - 3,124 @ 62%, 20-7, rd-7 WAS) expires off the best Rutgers offense of the B10 era; the replacement is a two-4*s August battle.

Lonergan (70.8/330 at BC, ACC +2 -> 72.8): 9 starts, 2,025 @ 67%, 12-5 - Saban-recruited, O'Brien-handpicked, strong September, then 'slowed down once opposing coordinators got some film, and he was eventually benched' (P6).
Surace (66.5/12): ex-4*, two-year incumbent backup, 'high ceiling but minimal snaps' (P6); Athlon lists him first, PS starts Lonergan.
The system case: Ciarrocca yr 4 with back-to-back top offenses and elite support (Raymond, Duff, two OL anchors).
52, M: the better tape (72.8 adj at 330 dropbacks) comes with a benching; the incumbent is unproven; the scheme and skill talent hold the floor at league-median-minus.
data_gaps: Lonergan's benching - film-adjustment or talent ceiling?

rationale_bullets: Raymond returns as the best returning RB tape in the B10 round: 89.0 PFF/244 att, 1,241 @ 5.1, 2nd-team All-B10, Doak Walker semifinalist - and the 41-carry/240-yard Purdue game ranks third all-time at Rutgers behind two Ray Rice games (P6).
The retention itself was the offseason's headline win (P6's three-requirements frame) - he closed 2025 with 161 vs Minnesota and 189 vs Penn State.
Support: Benjamin (73.4/68; 328 @ 4.8) and Thevenin (78.1/130 at LA Tech, CUSA -8 -> 70.1; 634 @ 4.8); RBLK graded p96 in '25.
PS: 'Raymond should net them a 4th-straight 1,000 yard rusher.'
74, M: an ~p92 tape workhorse at real volume, tempered by a rebuilt pass-pro line and a thinner room behind him.
data_gaps: OL pass-pro floor may force loaded boxes
no proven RB2 at P4 level

rationale_bullets: Duff is a true alpha: 83.4 PFF/438 routes (B10 -1 -> 82.4, ~p90 tape), 1,084 @ 18.1, 2nd-team All-B10, 6'6 with a 17-yard aDOT - 'one of the best players in the Big Ten this season' (Athlon).

Everything behind him left or is unproven: Strong (78.9/356) to Cal with a 4* exit ranking, Sheffield (61.8/419) and TE Fletcher (76.0/189) expired; Black (57.7/118) moves up; M. Thomas (76.2/6) and 4* true FR Carter man the slot; the TE room is Blake (47.6/23) + Anthony (45.7/101 at Ball St, MAC -7 -> 38.7).
PS still calls the corps 'strong'; Athlon expects a real competition behind Duff.
60, M: the Houston-78 exemplar shape (one elite volume leader over a thin cast) argues above the ~63 aggregate; the total lack of a proven #2 argues below. Graded at the midpoint of those pulls.

key_players.name: Dyzier Carter
key_players.evidence: recruit - top-10 class signee; Athlon slot WR1

rationale_bullets: Two proven anchors return via the yr4-skew overrides (both triple-print-evidenced): Asamoah (71.5 PFF/849 -> 70.5; consecutive All-B10 seasons; 'a lock' - Athlon) and Needham (67.6/751 -> 66.6; 20 st L2Y) - 'a combined 55 starts' (P6).

Two original '25 projected starters return from injury (Langsdale, Chin 61.2/98) and the C battle is Salami (68.8/49; PS C1) vs H. Zilinskas (11 st at Colorado '23-24); Giwa (79.1/111) mans RT with Vigna (81.3/23) rising.
GONE: G. Zilinskas (73.2/836) + Felter (69.8/846) graduated, White (65.6/755) to Colorado, Stone to Temple - three of the five volume tapes.
The split personality: RBLK graded p96 (Raymond's lanes) while pass pro collapsed (#127, 10% sack rate; PBLK p45). New OL coach (Turner).
50, M: anchor quality at league-average tape levels, real returning experience, but half the '25 volume is gone and the pass-pro floor is documented.
data_gaps: pass-pro fix under a new line coach

rationale_bullets: The entire 2025 starting line is gone: O'Neill (74.5/471; the top pass rusher), Weaver (61.1/402), Thompson (61.8/353) graduated, Walker (67.1/337) to Georgia Tech - off a front that allowed 284 rush ypg over the last six games with 2 sacks (PS).

The restock is an all-league G5 trio, every one a 3* transfer: Davis (81.5 PFF/442 at Toledo, MAC -6 -> 75.5; 3rd-team MAC, 5.5 sk), Burnett (79.2/526 at Tulsa, AAC -6 -> 73.2; 2nd-team AAC, 6.5 sk), Porter (79.2/534 at App State, SBC -6 -> 73.2).
Returning interior via yr4 overrides: Angoy (62.8/332 -> 72.8) + Griffin (63.4/305 -> 73.4) + Blue-Eli (injury return; 10 st at USF prior) + Gnago (76.0/102 -> 86.0 small).
Athlon's frame is the tell: 'coaches hope one of the defensive end transfers could be the first Scarlet Knight to collect five sacks in a season in a decade.'
54, M: the adjusted two-deep (~73) resembles the Wake-60 anchor but with ZERO returning P4 starter volume, a p3 as-played RDEF prior, and a first-year FCS coordinator - discounted below the anchor.
data_gaps: G5-to-B10 translation for all three imports

rationale_bullets: Two live returners: Wright (59.0 PFF/463, B10 +16 -> 75.0; 7 st, 58 tkl) and Moses Walker (68.0/137 -> 84.0) - OFY after four games; in '24 he was the first Rutgers soph over 100 tackles since 2020. Athlon BOLDS Walker as a returning starter (his yr4 feed-skew override was a ledger-review catch, documented in news.md).
The import: Morris (67.8/827 at Rice, AAC -11 -> 56.8) - All-AAC with 88 tkl and 9.5 tfl at genuine full volume, heavily discounted by the offset; Allison (Drake - Pioneer POY, 125 tkl) is FCS tape.
Djabome (51.0/659) expires - the weakest full-volume tape in the room leaves.
LB caution applied: Walker's 84.0 rides 137 snaps (injury-shortened, pedigree-corroborated - the Rojas pattern); Wright's 75.0 is offset-driven; Morris is the only full-volume '25 body.
54, M: 'Schiano is known for crafting solid LB corps' (PS); graded at the caution-weighted aggregate, in the MSU-53/Minnesota-55 tier.

The 2025 unit was the worst statistical defense P6 has ever graded (#131 opponent QB rating, #130 y/a, dead last adjusted) and then lost four of five starters: Mascoe (77.2/590 - the best tape) to Texas, Henderson (59.7/600) to Virginia, Elad (63.1/670) and C. Miller (56.8/660) expired.

The 'lone returning starter' (P6) is Sanders (45.6 PFF/620 -> 51.6) - poor tape at full volume; Levy (39.0/67), Ofurie (45.6/35; PS STUD1), and yr4-override Joines (67.3/38; 14 st at Mercer '24) fill roles.

The rebuild is FCS-first: Munn (South Dakota - FCS All-American, national INT leader, followed DC Johansen), Jones (Citadel), Dawud (Villanova; 13 pd) all 3* transfer grades, plus Humes (61.4/330 at Maryland -> 67.4) as the lone P4 import tape.
Schiano: cornerback is 'the most competitive' camp battle - all three spots new.

36, M: the round's lowest secondary grade - one adjusted tape above 67 (on 38 snaps), an FCS-translation bet at three spots, and a p3/p15 as-played floor. Above the FAU-6 band strictly on import quantity and coaching reset.

key_players.name: Mikey Munn
key_players.evidence: FCS All-American; led nation in INT; followed Johansen

rationale_bullets: ST rule: start at the p19 as-played SPEC (PS STR slide #23 -> #83 -> #107) and adjust for total continuity: K Patel (yr4 override; 13-18 LY but a school-record 83% in '23 and 15-19 with a 51-yarder in '24), P Anderson (41.8-41.9 net), KO man Scullion (33 TB), LS O'Connor all return.
The program identity is real: NCAA-leading 67 blocked kicks since '09; 'they remain very aggressive in trying to block kicks' (Athlon, who calls the '25 unit 'solid' - the one dissenting print).
No new legs to scout - the question is whether the Patel-era career level (top-30 STR '23) or the '25 slide is signal.
44, M: full personnel continuity and a proven-career K lift it off the as-played floor; the two-year results slide caps it below average.
